testcase.name: Scenario: Switch targets while an edit is pending: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:60:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch targets while an edit is pending ✔ Given the ribbon customization dialog has empty custom panel lists for "Part | Sketch" and "Part | Annotate" ✔ When the user selects "Part | Sketch" as the target ✔ And the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list ✔ And the user selects "Part | Annotate" as the target ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user returns to the "Part | Sketch" target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" is still in its custom panel list ✔ And the target selector indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
